Search for tasks. Either componentId or component can be provided, but not both. Requires the project administration ...

params.name: component
params.description: Key of the component (project) to filter on

params.name: componentId
params.description: Id of the component (project) to filter on

params.name: maxExecutedAt
params.description: Maximum date of end of task processing (inclusive)

params.name: onlyCurrents
params.description: Filter on the last tasks (only the most recent finished task by project)

params.name: ps
params.description: Page size. Must be greater than 0 and less or equal than 1000

params.name: q
params.description: Limit search to: component names that contain the supplied stringcomponent keys that are exactly the same as the supplied stringtask ids that are exactly the same as the supplied stringMust not be set together with componentId

params.name: status
params.description: Comma separated list of task statuses

items.docs: Search for tasks. Either componentId or component can be provided, but not both. Requires the project administration permission if componentId or component is set.
